scenario: A fake antivirus app requests device-admin rights and blocks its own uninstallation.

supported_findings: The app requests BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN and registers AdminLockReceiver, capabilities that can be used to resist uninstallation.
Strings reference a fake-threat-detection message, an uninstall-blocked message, and a pay-to-unlock endpoint, consistent with ransomware-style scareware design.
No traffic_log entries exist in this case, so no confirmed connection to the pay-to-unlock endpoint is recorded.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that a specific person paid a ransom or was successfully extorted -- no payment or transaction evidence exists in this case.
Any claim that device-admin lock was actually activated against a specific user -- only the capability is evidenced, not its exercise.
Any claim identifying who installed this app or why.
